title: The Unheard Chord
description: A woman picks up an instrument she abandoned years ago and plays just for herself.
character_reference: a woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length black hair and silver hoop earrings, wearing an oversized cable-knit cream sweater

scenes.narration: The acoustic guitar had stayed in its velvet-lined case in the back of the closet for nearly a decade.
scenes.visual: dark bedroom closet opening dusty velvet guitar case lying flat on the floor warm overhead bulb illumination

scenes.narration: Every time she thought about playing, old criticisms from a harsh teacher echoed loudly in her mind.
scenes.visual: close-up hand hovering over wooden guitar body hesitant expression shadow falling across the fretboard

scenes.narration: Tonight, she unlatched the rusty metal clasps anyway, letting the old familiar scent of cedar wood fill the room.
scenes.visual: fingers snapping open metal case latches lifting the wooden instrument out carefully warm lamplight

scenes.narration: Her fingertips were soft, and the strings felt unfamiliar and sharp against skin that had forgotten them.
scenes.visual: close-up pressing fingertips onto steel guitar frets slight wince of discomfort realistic skin texture

scenes.narration: She struck a single chord, and the rich, resonant sound vibrated straight through the floorboards.
scenes.visual: strumming hand caught in motion string vibrating motion blur warm room interior cozy atmosphere

scenes.narration: It wasn't perfect, and her timing slipped, but the music belonged entirely to her.
scenes.visual: medium shot eyes closed strumming acoustic guitar lost in the moment peaceful expression soft lighting

scenes.narration: She played into the empty room, realizing she didn't need applause to make her art worthwhile.
scenes.visual: wide shot sitting on edge of bed playing guitar peaceful solitary evening room illuminated by warm lamp

scenes.narration: If you are finding your way back to what you love, follow along for more stories.
scenes.visual: holding guitar neck smiling warmly at camera soft cozy bedroom background natural lighting
